snippet.title: Subnautica 2 | Early Access: First Dive Showcase
snippet.description:
Join us as the Unknown Worlds Dev Team takes you on an exclusive deep dive ahead of Subnutica 2's Early Access launch, alongside special guest @PointCrow!

Get ready for:

🎬 Gameplay Trailer Premiere
🎤 Developer Interviews
🎮 Gameplay Demos
🎁 Giveaways

And much more!

Subnautica 2 enters Early Access on May 14th, 2026, at 08:00 PDT / 15:00 UTC. 

✨ Wishlist Subnautica 2 Now ✨
